summary: The diff implements Set.prototype.symmetricDifference in its own file, following the spec steps. I checked it against the spec and found no defects. GetSetRecord runs its observable Gets, ToNumber, NaN/range checks and IsCallable checks in spec order. GetIteratorFromMethod runs after RequireInternalSlot, and the SetData copy runs in step 5 order. The per-key loop matches steps 7.a–7.b.v, including the tombstone semantics via delete. Errors propagate with `?`. Nothing is special-cased, and the unimplemented dependencies (size getter, SetIteratorPrototype.next, Map size) surface as not-implemented errors. The one concern is a GC rooting window, which is noted below and is not a spec defect.
notes_for_next_attempt: Possible GC rooting gap, unverified: keys_iterator.iterator and next_method are only Rust locals between ops::get_iterator_from_method and agent.with_roots. In that window the code calls agent.intrinsic and agent.object_with_kind, which may allocate on the GC heap. Consider rooting the iterator and next method immediately after GetIteratorFromMethod, or creating the result object inside the rooted region. Run with KAHVI_GC_STRESS=1 to confirm. Also, the get_set_record helper is duplicated from prototype_union.rs. The doc comment says so, and it should move to set/mod.rs once more Set methods need it. Remaining failures are only not-implemented dependencies (Set/Map size getters, SetIteratorPrototype.next).
